cases.selection_rule: all and only student failures from the frozen 8-case paired pilot; teacher succeeded on every selected case

design.nested_measurements: 300 candidates within CEM iteration; candidates are not independent replicates
design.pairing: teacher and student use identical CPU-generated standard-normal innovations for each case and iteration
design.teacher_pool_probe: score the teacher arm's exact candidate pool with both teacher and student
design.student_pool_shadow: score the student arm's exact candidate pool with student and frozen teacher
design.free_run: teacher and student update separate mu/sigma distributions from their own costs

claim_boundary.allowed: A fixed-initial-state CEM mechanism diagnosis on the six failed cases from paired pilot 24544733.pbs101.
forbidden: causal attribution to spatial mean pooling
evidence beyond the frozen six failed cases
